title: Blocked recipients
hint: A message to these addresses bounced or was marked as spam, so Mail stopped sending to them across the team to protect your domains' reputation.
checkError: {address}: couldn't check the block right now.
adminOnly: {address} is blocked. Only the team owner or an admin can unblock it.
notBlocked: {address} is no longer blocked. You can send now.
complaint: {address} marked a message as spam. That block can't be lifted: remove the address from this message.
bounced: {address}: a message bounced on {date} (address doesn't exist or refused it).
bouncedUndated: {address}: a message bounced (address doesn't exist or refused it).
confirm: Unblock {address}? Only do this if you're sure the address exists now or works again (for example, a typo fixed or a mailbox recreated). Another bounce hurts delivery of every message from your domains.
sesPending: The sending provider still has this address on its bounce list; the next messages may be dropped until the MepMail team finishes lifting it.
sendAgain: Done: go back to the draft and send again.
forbidden: Couldn't unblock: only the team owner or an admin can, and an address marked as spam can't be unblocked.
error: Couldn't unblock right now. Try again.
